newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Czech Republic - March 10.

text.p: PRAVO - Teachers plan to demonstrate on the streets of Prague as another method to obtain higher wages. They will remain ready to strike and will organise a petition against the proposal to increase teaching hours.
- CKD Praha Holding became co-owner of Inpro a.s., which has a majority stake of 51 percent of Inpro. On February 27, CKD owned 23.32 percent of shares of Inpro.

- Trade Minister Vladimir Dlouhy announced that, although there are only two parties entered in the tender for Aero Vodochody so far, the tender will not be cancelled. The time for applying will only be extended by four weeks.

- Last week, the director of Czech Railways, Rudolf Mladek, announced his readiness to resign. The vice-chairman of the company's administrative council, Otto Slavik, regards Vladimir Sosna, the director of the business operations division, as the best man to take over Mladek's position.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - From April 16, Vratislav Kulhanek, currently the director of Robert Bosch Ceske Budejovice, will become the new chairman of the board at Skoda Mlada Boleslav. Detlef Wittig, currently a member of the board responsible for sales and marketing, will become the vice-chairman of the board, replacing Volkhard Kohler.
- Finance Minister Ivan Kocarnik will present a proposal for budget cuts to the cabinet this week.
- Skoda Plzen and its 100 percent subsidiaries had gross profits of 366.7 million crowns with expenses of 31.57 billion crowns last year, according to the Prague Stock Exchange.

MLADA FRONTA DNES - The state decided to offer no-interest loans of 200,000 crowns to individuals as aid for housing construction, which should be paid back within two years of their issue date. The cabinet should discuss the proposal for the loans this week.

- The expert commission which is analysing the proposal for reforms presented by Miroslav Macek, secretary to Health Minister Jan Strasky, agreed yesterday with most of the necessary changes in the proposal.
LIDOVE NOVINY - Imports of oil increased last year by 24 percent to 26.40 billion crowns, according to the Czech Statistical Bureau. Pipeline Ingolstadt began operations last year.

- Robert Zmelik obtained the first gold medal in the history of the Czech Republic for the world indoor championship heptathlon in Paris. Bronze medals were won by triple jumper Sarka Kasparkova and 400 metre runner Helena Fuchsova.
